rules.title: Xcode DerivedData
rules.description: Intermediate build products and indexes, regenerated on the next build (which is slower the first time).

rules.title: SwiftUI previews cache
rules.description: Simulated environments for Xcode Previews, rebuilt when needed.

rules.title: Device support files (iOS / watchOS / tvOS DeviceSupport)
rules.description: Symbols downloaded when debugging on a device. Versions unused for 30 days are downloaded again the next time you connect such a device.

rules.title: Xcode Archives (older than 180 days)
rules.description: Archives of old builds. Without them you can’t symbolicate crash reports from those versions, so make sure you no longer need them.

rules.title: Simulator caches
rules.description: CoreSimulator’s dynamic caches. Apps and data inside simulators are not affected.

rules.title: Swift Package Manager cache
rules.description: Downloaded package sources, downloaded again when needed.

rules.title: npm cache
rules.description: npm’s download cache (_cacache), downloaded again when needed.

rules.title: pnpm cache
rules.description: pnpm’s metadata cache. The package store is not included; use pnpm store prune for that.

rules.title: Homebrew download cache
rules.description: Downloaded installers. Installed packages are not affected.

rules.title: Cargo registry cache
rules.description: Rust crate archives and extracted sources, downloaded again when needed.

rules.title: Gradle cache
rules.description: Dependency and build caches. The next build downloads them again and may take longer.

rules.title: Go build cache
rules.description: The go build cache, rebuilt automatically.

rules.title: node-gyp headers cache
rules.description: Headers used to compile native Node modules.

rules.title: Playwright browsers
rules.description: Test browsers downloaded by Playwright; run npx playwright install to get them again.
